1) GPS IS HORRIBLE!!!  For instance last weekend I took my mother out to lunch to eat. It’s a 20 minute drive to the restaurant, we spent approximately 90 minutes eating, a 20 minute drive home, and also a quick stop by the local drug store. THE ENTIRE 2.5 HOURS WE WERE OUT THE APP SHOWED SHE WAS AT HOME!!!  She had the necklace around her neck the entire duration!!!  Even the days the GPS is working (occasionally), it is off by blocks!!!

2)  RESPONSE IS HORRIBLE!!!  Last week my mother had an episode and hit the button on her pendant. Due to the fact she passed out, she was unable to answer any questions from the dispatcher.  Emergency services were never called and occasionally the company would call her home phone to see if she picked up. Finally, after 40 MINUTES I receive a call from GreatCall stating they are unable to get into contact with my mother and request I check to ensure her safety and call them back.  REALLY??  40 MINUTES BEFORE THE FIRST CALL IS PLACED TO A POINT OF CONTACT??

3) APP IS TERRIBLE!!!  I already mentioned the GPS flaws, the response to emergencies not being even par, but finally the clunky app.  The app keeps a log of every time the button is pressed, which is great!!!  Too bad it doesn’t update until the next day!!!  The quickest I’ve ever received an app notification was 5 HOURS LATER!!!  

The sad thing is I pay extra for all these features, I think like $38/month for the highest package.  I’m not sure what else exists on the market but a tin can telephone for communication coupled with a jingle bell collar is quite comparable.

title: No good for mom
text: I don’t believe this is working for my mom.  She has dimentia and just wAnts to play with it and push the button. How do I cancel it? Do I need to return it since I paid for it?

title: If you care about your loved one, this is NOT the device or App for you
text: Please be advised that if your loved one falls down , 5 star is activated, then your loved one moves and mistakenly depresses the button again with their body positioning 5 STAR WILL NOT CONTACT EMERGENCY SERVICES,5STAR WILL NOT TRY TO CONTACT YOUR INJURED LOVED ONE AND WILL NOT CONTACT THE EMERGENCY CONTACTS. Yes, this is true, my father had this happen and was by himself, broken shoulder, and 5Star never even activated his device to ask if he was ok. He lay outside injured and unable to move for over an hour before a stranger found him. 5 Star supervisor confirmed that yes, this is their policy. So please, prevent a similar tragedy happening to your loved one ( we never know exactly what position they’ll fall in and how they’ll move after they’ve fallen) and know that this device will be useless and the company firmly backs their policy regarding this type of fall. Please choose another device for your loved one so they do not need to suffer as my father did.

title: Disappointed
text: We bought this for my 87 year old mother. It worked great for a year and now all of a sudden the app doesn’t even register that my mom is using the necklace. I don’t know how to get that fixed. The app does not notify you when the button on the necklace is pushed. You get a message on your phone but it doesn’t beep when delivered. That is not good when you are caring for an elderly lady with a heart condition.

title: Service is way overrated
text: The online service worked great for the first 6 months and it was all down hill from there. The unit stopped communicating with the online service so I had no status of my moms whereabouts or notifications when an emergency alert was sent out. 2 times within a month I didn’t find out that my mom was taken by ambulance to the hospital until the next day when a relative called to let me know. I would recommend looking for an other service that is reliable.

title: Peace of mind
text: Peace of mind for me as a husband and caregiver of my wife who has suffered 2 strokes and is unable to walk without assistance.

title: Not happy
text: Constantly showing my mom leaving in the middle of the night when we know she’s in bed. Once it showed her in Russia!!! Or showing her out and about but device is charging. Not thrilled with all the inaccuracies

title: Great service, great care
text:
I have Parkinson’s disease and find it a great relief to have this device. It has fall detection and GPS so no matter where I am authorities will know where to find me.

I have to say that everyone I have spoken to from Great Call has been so courteous and professional. 

I highly recommend this company.

title: Daughter with peace of mind
text:
I feel so much better knowing that I can find my mother and knowing that she can get help at the push of a button. The support staff have been wonderful the few times that I have called them with very minor technical issued that were very easy to fix. The app link makes it fast and easy to monitor her with my iPhone. The iPhone app is a lot easier and faster than having to use the Web site from my phone.  11/13/15. Still working Great!

I had to replace my mother’s old device because the old one finally stopped working. I got the new one February 20, 2018. It works when she pushes the button, but I have had some problems with the new device which I’m told is due to the link app. It no longer shows me her daily activity. I miss being able to see were she went during the day. Before, I could tell how she was by seeing were she had gone during the day. It also shows her location, accurately, but when she is at her home address, it says she is out and about. Even though her safety information has her home address, the app always says “ out and about “. I’ve called customer service several time and they are always very nice and try to help, but is still won’t show her daily activity. I think the app needs to do another update to fix the problem. I still feel better with her wearing the device, but I am frustrated that I still can’t track her daily activity. Hopefully they will do another bug fix and update the app link so that I can see her daily activity like I could do before she got this new device.
2019. It still works but it still won’t show daily activity the way the original did. I guess they never did a bug fix update. I’m still glad she has it but I wish it worked like the original. I now use Life360 to see a record of her daily activity.

title: Outstanding !!!
text: Great call is just that .... great little, accurate “fall” and tracking device that is being worn faithfully by my Mother - the customer service has been so helpful and patient every time that she, or one of us children have called them . I would highly recommend this company, their device, and their service ! Thumbs up Great Call !!!

title: Not working
text:
The first day my mother had it, the app gave me her whereabouts. Every day since then it has said the device was off (I know for a fact it was on) & she couldn't be tracked. I un & reinstalled app, didn't help. 
What good is it if it doesn't work?

title: Updates unreliable
text: We got the Lively to help Mom be more independent. We liked that we would receive notifications when she left home, returned, forgot to charge device, fell or called for help. We were also supposed to be able to “search” for her. For awhile we did receive notifications. Then the would come hours after the event(she would be home before we even were notified that she was out). Now we get nothing. Even the weekly updates are inaccurate often saying she is out 1x a week when I’ve had her out several while she was wearing the charged unit. Undependable for notifications. Since mom has not had a true emergency, I don’t even know if that works. My advice...keep looking for better option

title: Unsatisfied
text: We have a button that my Mom wears around her neck. It’s caused her and us quite a bit of frustration because battery doesn’t last through an entire day and there’s no way to quickly swap it out for a fresh one. We ended up ordering a new one hoping it might last longer but it had trouble during setup. Tech support advised her to do a hard reboot which requires two buttons to be pressed at the same time, but her hands are weak and she doesn’t have the dexterity to do it herself. It’s simply. It just not senior friendly. Last complaint is the app. I found it clunky and unreliable. It is supposed to show the batter life, mom’s location, and whether she’s had any events. The information was rarely accurate and available when I checked it. So all in all, I would not suggest this system unless you have someone nearby that can help, which kind of defeats the purpose of allowing us to be away from our Mom and have peace of mind that she’s okay.

title: the app but won’t let me login
text: I got this service to keep my Dad safe but the app doesn’t let me login in after I set up online! Website doesn’t have answers either, please have simple fix for this on your website to save time and a phone call

title: No longer updates location!
text: Really liked this app for a couple of years.  But after a company software tweak earlier this month app no longer supports my mother’s Great Call device. Keeps saying the device is out of service when it is not.  Then must fetch and wait for the location to show up on app map.  Takes too much time.  Really disappointed.  Will look at other brands to replace this one.

title: It’s ok...
text: The location reporting is slow and is not real time. I can get a weekly report but it doesn’t show a map of where the Lively has been. It’s mostly an advertisement telling me that Livey was ready to help... but grandma didn’t call them.

title: Not a good App
text: This app is not accurate and does not allow me to keep up with my elderly father via smartphone. I’m very disappointed.

title: I was put on hold
text:
This week in review said my mother made no 911 calls.  That is not true and she was taken by ambulance to the hospital and I was NEVER notified!!!!  Why did this happen????

Also, when we first received this monitor, I did the test call when we first set up the Call necklace, we were put on hold for several minutes before they even answered.

title: Not impressed
text: My mother has been in hospital for an extended period of time.   Her Lively is home on charger yet we get alerts telling us she’s out and about! Doesn’t give me any confidence that In an emergency I can locate her!

title: Poor care giver involvement
text:
No proximity locator
No 911 call to caregivers if the push and hold
No call to caregivers that they push lightly and talk 
No 911 ticket reference for door key location

title: Poor response if unit is lost or not working
text: My father lost his months ago and the company still reported him as being home if he was laying on a floor somewhere obviously no one would contact me

title: Problems
text: Cannot get a home location on the app so mom is listed as out and about all the time?!’ Unsafe as we cannot tell when she leaves home, no notifications, banners etc.  please get this fixed!

title: Great way to track seniors with poor health
text:
We are enjoying Great Link and the updates we receive about our loved one who is wearing the necklace.
We miss the update that used to show why Great Link was called and why.  Being states away, once we receive the message Great Link was contacted we freak out till we can reach our mom.
Please put this feature back in the message that sends out the notification when you all were contacted and what all happened.

title: Unhappy
text: The concept is great idea. It does take awhile to locate my mom and sometimes not accurate but I dealt with anyway and having the ability to have emergency service available anytime and anywhere was reassuring. I am now having a hard time with the app. It was on my phone and then disappeared. I tried downloading multiple times but does not download. This is worrisome. Wishing it worked. I will probably sever my con contract.

title: Not happy with this company
text: My husband has had at least 8 bad falls, we carry the fall feature and it never goes off and we are on the second one and pay extra for fall feature. We definitely would not recommend this company at all!

title: Location
text:
Sitting in the same room w/my mother next to me and tapped location...when the alert was finally located it showed her two blocks from home.

Really!!!!!

title: Needs work.
text: Love the concept of the app but it has proven unreliable.  There have been times my dad has been out and about and it hasn’t let me know.  I think with some perfecting it would be a 5 star app

title: Not Great
text: Device has been “failing” to locate elderly parent, is on his third device. Is very frustrating - would not recommend.  No tall buildings mountains & so forth.  Great Call sends monthly update via the app and says “however, didn’t use for three days” — when those were the days he was waiting for a new device — ridiculous.  Look elsewhere.  Cannot recommend in good conscience.  Waste of caregiver’s sanity, trust and pease of mind.

title: Where’s the info?
text:
For the last three weeks, I have received a prompt from GreatCall telling me my mother’s week in review is ready see. However, when I hit the link, an error message appears saying there were issues contacting the server, and basically no data is available. And the 5 Star may or may not be available.  I initially assumed this was a “one off” but now it appears to be a constant. So, after today I will contact GREATCALL - if they don’t respond to this review. 
This service is not acceptable.

title: Review
text: Mom cannot see charge light so she cannot tell if the unit is fully charged. My mobile app does not accurately show when the unit is charged or if she is wearing it. The app seemed to work good the first day when I could tell that the unit was still on the charger. When she put it on we were quickly notified but now it takes hours.

title: Keeping track of mom
text: The use is extremely sluggish. With all the GPS technology we have today why is this app so slow?

title: Comforting
text: I gave the app only 4 stars because a lot of the time, my Mom’s location is at a range of addresses (ie 1234-1243) instead of her actual home address. Otherwise, it’s comforting to me to know if she’s had to call or is charging which is indicating that’s she’s sleeping.

title: Great Call App
text: This app has not been sending me notifications for my Mother’s Lively Mobile medical alert device for three months now! I have called approximately 8 times and spent hours on the phone with untrained, inefficient staff and my app still does not work. I’m switching her to another medical device program as soon as possible!

title: Great call and five star
text:
My sister and I have been told varying reasons as to why the app doesn’t update real time. My sister was told it was because of her wireless carrier however her and I are with different carriers (metropcs and at&t). I was told it was just not able to update in real-time. 

Our father fell in his bathroom of the independent living facility where he resides.  Emergency services were dispatched around 5:30 am yet the app didn’t notify her until 7:15! Both my sister and I called great call to try and locate my father. I was told EMS had NOT been called. Neither my sister or I were called to be informed of the emergency. It took them 9 days to get back to me to explain why! I was told it was their error and they were sorry! Really? I would be leery of using this service for your loved one as they may not notify you until it’s too late! Terrible service

title: Works Sporadically!
text:
I’m sitting in the house with my dad and my app has been searching for his GC device for 10 min.  It is fully charged and I have rebooted the app twice. The push notifications come about 45 minutes delayed so if he’s driving for 30 min back and forth to the store I never know about it. I’m sitting in the same house and the device is being charged yet the app has been searching for him all this time. NOT ACCEPTABLE!!!!

Come on folks. This is a life and death situation.  Your device and app needs to work!

title: Great call app
text: I’m somewhat disappointed in the app. It will tell me my mom is out & about when she hasn’t left the house all day. I think the premise of the app is good, but needs refinement. Sometimes it tells me she’s home when she is not. I think this app could be so much better than it is.

title: Don’t do business here
text: My mother’s device broke.... just the spring clip.  Great Call was notified numerous times..... the device could not be used without the clip.... but Great Call continued to bill her.... to take funds for a service that was NOT being performed for months.  Disgusting.

title: Not good for locating quickly!!!
text:
This app is inadequate if you’re trying to track someone in a vehicle. We experienced an emergency situation where our mother got disoriented and was lost for a number of hours. Great Call only updated her position roughly every 20-25 minutes. If your loved one is on foot that’s probably good enough. If they’re in an automobile there’s literally no way to locate them unless they stop and stay in one place for over 25 minutes. 

We called Great Call and notified them this was an emergency situation. They stated that heir software only allowed even THEM to update her position every 25 minutes or so. There was NOTHING they could do. 
LIFE 360 app is far superior, but requires an iPhone. Please keep in mind the significant limitations of this app when your loved ones’ welfare is on the line.

title: I appreciate this app and the service it  provides
text: I am disappointed with the accuracy of the map and how slow it is and the fact that sometimes she's sitting right beside me and I still can't find her so I hope that you all can make this app do what it should be. I think it should be 100% accurate when you're dealing with people you love this is a serious thing and when it's not operating at your quote on quote five stars which I would give it about two stars. step your game up a call so much money to use this service you should take care of the elderly and the people didn't need you not your bottom line

title: Not too helpful.
text: This app could be a lot better. When it says my Mom is home, it shows the location about three miles away. I am not sure how emergency responders are going to find her if she activated an emergency call. The app also indicated she was home all day on a day she had two doctors appointments. Granted, she may have left the unit at home on the charger. Still early so maybe this app will grow on me over time. The idea is good.

title: Constantly wrong information and/or locations alerts sent.
text: We needed thus for our 87 year young Mom who goes all over the place. It’s the only way to keep track of her but in the last few months we keep getting false alerts, ie: that she is somewhere across town at 4:30 am. Sometimes we can’t find her location for hours. So we were told we need to upgrade the device. (It’s less than 2 years old). Their app needs work from someone who knows what they’re doing. It could be great but it’s only so so.

title: Great App
text: This App works great to know where my elderly father is and if jitterbug phone is charged and if he is having a medical emergency wherever I am. I highly recommend this App.

title: Generally unreliable
text:
Sometimes it is ok, others not at all. My mom' s device was powered off for over a week, losing charge. Never notified it was off.  Weekly summary merely said that she only wore it three days during the week.  Nonsensical (and hokey) wording for what really occurred.  
Another emergency situation she pushed the button  and the tech had not taken adequate notes and they could not tell us what had happened.  Location on the device was not registering for HOURS either so we had no way of knowing where she had been taken.  Thankfully she was ok, but if it had been serious, we had no way to reach her. Her cell phone was left in the car when she was taken by ambulance.  Technology does not seem to be a vein that of a standard smartphone. 
Will be looking for a new service soon.

title: Lively Alert
text: Unfortunately the app doesn’t always work.  My mom will have the device on her but the app says she’s home.

title: Everything great but...
text:
I love the great call service. It is everything I could have hoped for for my 92 year old father. 

Only thing that they need to improve is battery life. Even with a full overnight charge it doesn't last a full day I.e. From 8 am to 11 pm.

title: Poor hardware lanyard setup
text: My mother was unable to install the lanyard which I understand is a companywide problem. Others could not do it either. Our daughter from Chicago did it for her but the magnet broke and the lanyard did not stay closed and the daughter  was not present to help. They sent a replacement lanyard but my mom's fingers couldn't depress a small square on the back of the unit so she couldn't replace the old with the new lanyard. We were on the phone with someone from Great Call who admitted this was a general problem. The company is unable for some unknown reason, to pre install the lanyard. I was very upset my 92 year old mom was left without a lanyard and they are expecting IRMA a cat. 5 hurricane to hit Florida this week. I would not recommend this alert system unless they fix the LANYARD issue.

title: Inconsistent coverage
text:
I am linked to this app to keep me in touch with an elderly friend I assist. Frequently the app will say that the device is off or not in service.  When I contact my friend, his device is working but I don't have access because my link is not working. I spoke with technical support who told me to logout, turn off my mobile phone and wait a few minutes and then turn the phone back on and log in. It fixed the problem when I was talking with tech support.  However, today I had the same problem.  I tried logging out, turning off my phone about 3 different

 times. Continued to state the device was either turned off or out of service.  I deleted the app and downloaded the app again. When I logged in I got the same message. Again I logged out n then turned off my phone for a few minutes and then went through the process of turning my phone back on and logging in again.  It now shows that the device is on and the battery is charging. My friend is diligent about wearing the device and charging it nightly.  If I can not get consistent and accurate information from my link that is a problem.  Also, it is concerning that technical support is not available 24/7. If this device is meant to aid the elderly or persons with medical issues technical support should be available or at least have a tech person on call that can handle any incoming request for assistance.  This is my 1st experience with Great Call and it's device.  At this time I am frustrated with the inconsistency and the lack of tech staff to assist outside of regular  customer service hours.  I hope improvements will be made.

Frustrated caregiver

title: Not good from my perspective
text: GPS is extremely slow if it works at all. Locations are not accurate (when it is working). Reports my 82 year old mother is out and about at 3am.  I thought she was having a problem and frightened her with a call at that time of night.  It often shows her out when she's home during the day. What good is that? I'm a firefighter and I respond to people who use these types of services and the locations are accurate and I recommend them. I don't trust this system, and will look into something else.

title: BEWARE!
text: I am reinstalling the app at the recommendation of GC customer support. I have been reporting gross (6 to 10 mile) location reporting errors for a week now and now believe I am just get the jerk around. Got one of their reps to admit they are trying to fix a known problem. Have already followed their "reboot the device" and the app reboot nonsense. Based on the other reviews, they clearly have a big problem. So, is my 93-year-old mother at home or is she wandering around in the rain in her nightgown at what is reported as an "unknown location" miles away? No way to know! Thanks for worse than nothing Great Call!!

title: Massive GPS Location errors
text: I got a message that my 94 year old mother had left her home and was about 60 miles from it. Surprised And concerned I called her to find her home. Calls to "Great  Calls"  customer support were frustrating with initial refusal to even talk to me and they would not respond to the problem. I learned, from customer support eventually that you should turn device on and off frequently so it could get upgrades otherwise it doesn't work. Defective product, incompetent support. A device that purports to track you elderly patent and tells you she suddenly left the house and is 60 mikes from home needs to be removed from the market. It's defective.

title: Complete garbage
text: I bought my dad the phone because of this app. It worked for a few months, and now it tells me that his phone is off- and I know it's not off. A huge waste of time.

title: Love it for mom
text: Allows me to keep track of my elderly mom's whereabouts and phone status.

title: Works well
text: This is a device that gives a bit greater sense of peace for us-- 4 siblings of a 96 year old living alone. I like the weekly report and the notices when Mom's device battery is getting low so we can call her to advise.

title: Excellent app
text: I love this app! I am able to check in on my dad during the day and see what he's up to. I like the notifications keeping me updated throughout the day. He's pressed it accidentally a few times, and the response was prompt each time. I feel reassured that if he ever needs to use it for an emergency, he will be well taken care of.

title: Somewhat disappointed
text: My mom had been using the splash until it broke last week. We had issues with it sinking to the app that were never resolved. Sometimes it worked, sometimes not. Now my mother has the Lively. We seem to be having the same problem only worse. It takes forever for it to update to her current location. It could be hours until it recognizes she's changed locations. I was told this device would be much more accurate than the splash but that doesn't seem to be the case. It's also more difficult for my elderly mother to reboot the Lively and the chimes are at a different frequency and sound is lower, making it more difficult for her to hear if I have her reboot the device. I suggest you hire an older person to test this product, as they can give you more accurate feedback on correcting the problems.

title: Good but don't rely on frequent GPS updates
text: Sitting in ER with my aunt (after she used her Great Link Splash to call for EMTs) and the app was saying she was still at home when she'd left home by ambulance an hour ago. Should provide more frequent updates, especially for a longer period of time after an emergency call.

title: Generally Pretty Good
text: It took a while for the device to learn my mother's movements and we did get some erroneous locations at first but I am generally pleased with the device and the app. She has not us d it for an actual emergency call yet but I feel fairly confident that it will be fine.

title: Exceeded Expectations
text: Great way to "train" the wearer because the app lets you know if they are wearing it or not!! I have to keep reminding my father to put it on!! When he actually does wear it, I can see where he is and this gives me peace of mind. Seems to be a great company but wish they made a watch that had all the features of the lively. My father would definitely remember to wear it then.

title: Great device!
text: My brother bought this for our elderly mother. So far we have been very pleased.   Today though when she left home and when she got back home the timing was off. Said she left home at 8:15am and didn't get back until 3pm.  She was actually only gone about an hour, left around 10 and got back at 11 or so.

title: When it works, it's great.
text: About every other week, I get the message that the device may be off or not in service when it is. It will usually reset after a few hours, but occasionally I have to go over to my mom's and spend 30 minutes on the phone with GCL's tech team. They have great customer service but it's frustrating that it happens so often. And during that time, there's no way to know if she's at home or out and about.

title: Peace of Mind
text: The app has been a wonderful link to help keep tabs on my Dad. The times I have needed to contact customer service, they have been very helpful.

title: Perfect for my 89 year old Mother!
text: I was hesitant to purchase as I did not know anyone locally who had a jitterbug. We live in a rural area of Illinois and I was worried it would not have a signal. I decided to take the chance and it is absolutely awesome! My mother can use it with no issues. I purchased the five star piece so that she has a button to push if she has an emergency. It is peace of mind and I highly highly recommend it!

title: Wonderful Peace of Mind
text: This app is just what we needed to be able to keep tabs on our elderly mother while she continues to live an independent lifestyle.

title: Simply the best!
text: A must have for anyone with older parents. Fantastic for checking in and peace of mind. Pairs perfectly with the jitterbug.

title: An easy way to check on my mom
text: This app is simply amazing. My mother has the Lively medical alert device made by GreatCall and with this app on my iPhone I can tell where she has been during the day. The app will alert me if the battery for her device needs charging too. Plus if she ever pushes the button for 5Star emergency service I will get alerted through the app right away. This app is great peace of mind for me to know my mother is safe.

title: Underwhelming
text: The app has some nice features but is not always accurate. It says my mom is out but I am talking to her in her own home. Locations are also not always accurate and updating them is not easy to do.

title: Inaccurate GPS
text: Great concept, horrible performance.  Shows my mom at locations she's not at currently at or a location she's never been.

title: Great concept, variable execution
text:
I got this phone for my mother-in-law primarily for my ability to use the app to understand what is going on in her world. 

Unfortunately, after a week or so the app and the phone disconnected and Greatcall can't seem to figure out why. A bigger concern is the fact that you wait well over a half an hour to talk to someone who simply tells you to power the phone down and bring it back up. 
If you are buying the phone for the App as I did, beware that you may get disappointed

title: Malfunctioning app and poor customer service
text:
I have tried to use this application with a lively wearable device. This application has contacted 5 star 4 times without me activating the device in the one week I've had it. The last straw was when they alerted emergency services today. I was not having an emergency nor did I activate the device. It wasn't even on my person. 
I have contacted technical support at least 5 out of the 7 days I've had this device. This device has worked in the opposite direction of security because I've had so much aggravation dealing with the technical problems which has not helped me or my family while I have been recovering from a stroke. I'm definitely returning the device and I would not recommend this device or the app or customer and technical support.

title: Phone is great, but..........
text:
I bought this phone for my mother to use.  The account etc is in my name but she has it with her in a LTC facility.  I'm Online wont allow me to make changes because she has the phone?  What's that about when it's in my name!  The 5 Star call Link app is WORTHLESS.  It tries to sign in and crashes before it's done signing in,  by the way we've been working on this problem since August and still no closer to resolving the issue.  
She loves the actual phone.  It's straightforward, easy to use, lightweight and call volume is good however the original charger won't stay plugged into the phone, very loose. Mom thinks it's charging when actually the charger is so loose that there's no connection.  I've tried other chargers and they charge if I'm holding it and when I set it down it breaks the connection. DO NOT believe that it will hold a charge in standby mode for weeks, it doesn't.  I charged it 100% and didn't use the phone.  Within 5 hours it had drained 7% of the battery.  Customer service is sub par at best from advertisements. Verizon is the service provider which is great but I would go elsewhere for a phone.

title: Great Call, so so app.
text: The idea is great in practice  not so much. I figured it would work like the apple find my phone app. Then I could monitor the device for motion without disturbing mom. It only polls a couple times an hour or less. Manual checks are spotty. Apparently the device is dependent on the verizon network. Support was good showing the effort. If it worked like find my phone it would be 5 stats. As it is id give it a 2.

title: Paid for no service
text: My mother in law is elderly and has trouble getting around. A few weeks ago we got a great call device paid $30 activation fee it and 2 days later paid another $30 for first month. The original device did not work. After tech support could not fix they sent a new one and after that came, 2 weeks, $60 and countless hrs on tech support they said they had to send another device. I asked for a refund and was told we can not do refunds. Worst app/company I have ever dealt with. Please find another product they done care about people just payments

title: Unit is great App is crap
text: Love that my mom has the unit for he safety since I am not local. App is worthless as it is rarely correct.  Now shows unit is off with no battery, but it is fine and working for mom.  Shows her out when she is home, in a wrong location or a location from 4 hours ago.  Needs major work and more frequent updating. Great Call calms it updates multiple times an hour but it does not.

title: Shows constantly that phone is off
text: The app worked well at first, but then began to show that phone was off all the time. I believed it at first, but then I'd call my mom and she answered! Obviously her phone was not off! If it is showing her phones is off, though, it is not helping to keep track of her, is it. This is disappointing. 🙁

title: Terrible app
text: The phone for my mom works, but I can't track her activities which is the real reason I bought it. I have spent HOURS on the phone with tech support, they can't seem to find a permanent solution.

title: Invaluable to me and Mom
text: I love it because the app wants me to call my mom and tell her to put it on the charger on the battery is low. She loves it because she has a great sense of security. My mother is very independent and still drives us to the grocery store close to the gym and works out. She has two groups that she meets for lunch to her three times a month. I can always track her through the app and she feels comfortable that if she falls or gets into an accident I'll she has to do is punch the button and help is on the way. The safety and sense of security versus the price was fantastic!

title: Reassurance
text: This app helps give give reassurance that my dad is safe and has instant contact with help when needed.

title: Doesn't work
text: I've tried and tried to use this app to check on my mom.  Every time I try to log in, the app quits. Useless. (iPhone 6S)

title: AWESOME APP
text: Love being able to know my Mom is okay & be able to keep track of where she is should she ever have a medical emergency!

title: Great Call
text: I and my family have been using this and it's a very excellent app and excellent way to keep informed of your loved one!! I use it to check on the battery life of my device.

title: App does not work
text: The only notifications I get anymore are mom is out and about or mom is home but they aren't even accurate. All the other features that worked great for a few days disappeared and haven't worked for months. The button works but the app is terrible.

title: Absolutely Wonderful!
text: We love this app. We are 3 hrs away from my father-in-law, this app has provided much comfort in knowing his location. It's proven very accurate and reliable.

title: App isn't accurate
text:
Overall I like the concept. My concerns are: 
1. Size. It's large and bulky to wear. Mother in law doesn't like to wear it to bed cuz its uncomfortable. 
2. App isn't accurate when battery is getting low. It says "good" and then "critical." 
3. More frequent app/location refresh would be nice. 
4. Seems antiquated. My watch (Pebble) is more advanced and considerably smaller. 
5. Appreciate that you can speak to someone through it. 
6. Like that it's water proof. 
7. Want longer battery life, i.e., 1-3/4 days isn't very long when told initially it would last 3-5 days.

title: App is useless
text: Does not work. Can't locate my dad; online can. Mobile app is utterly useless.

title: Ms
text: We purchased this for our mom. The device doesn't keep a charge and the app on my phone that's to be used to check in on her will not connect. Thinking about another service if Great Call cannot remedy this.

title: Helps the long distance relationship
text:
After a series of falls and a couple of 911s my mom finally gave in and let us get her a cell phone. I jumped on the opportunity to get the Jitterbug, and she and my siblings are all content with the new closeness it has given us. 
Knowing where she is, and that she isn't tied to a land line, is great comfort. 
No regrets.

title: Peace of Mind
text: Exactly what my family needed to keep tabs on our mother who lives alone.  The GPS lets me know if she is home or out and whether battery needs to be charged.  The app is a great check-in throughout the day while I am at work!  No contracts was nice also - just pay month to month 😀

title: Great Call App Does Not Deliber
text: Bought the splash device for my 90 year old mother. Great Call promised the app would help me monitor her location. Location doesn't work. All I get is her battery status and if she made any calls to Great Call. Very disappointed in the apps performance.

title: For my 94y old Dad
text: We bought our first great call flip phone for my Dad back in May. Not only has the location app rarely worked but we are now on our 3rd phone because of constant problems. I am still constantly having to go to his house and call tech support for one problem or another. While tech support is always very helpful the problems continue to recur.  If I felt like I had a choice I would have cancelled this service a long time ago. However he has very low vision and can only use a phone that is voice activated, this is why we are still suffering through with it.

title: Great extra eye!
text: I love this app because I live in California and my father lives in Michigan!  It has not given me false information and it's a blessing to be able to track his daily activities!  It alerts me when the battery is low so I can remind him to charge it! The map has always displayed accurate information, as I confirm with him his daily activities. Having this app has given me the peace of mind I need since I'm so far away!

title: Waste of time!
text: I've wasted so much time with customer service trying to get the app to work. I've had it for months and still can't use it. GPS on Jitterbug phone only shows home location. Power status only says her phone is off when it's actually always on. Battery power always shows zero. Very irritating sine the app was major reason we bought this phone for Mom.

title: Junk! I have lost all confidence in GreatCall
text:
This app had some problems before, but since the update it is a useless service. All we see now is that the "battery is good" and no "5 Star Calls this week". The Spash was restarted and that did no good. I uninstalled and installed again and that did not work. The previous version was also buggy. One time it reported that the Spash was being charged and at my mother's house. Wrong. She was in the emergency room, with the Splash in her possession!!! 
We will be cancelling this soon. My mother got this for peace of mind for her and us. What a joke.

title: Horrible Update
text: I was relying on the GPS information to verify my mom's location and whether she was charging her Splash. I also looked forward to the week in review. The update is completely useless. I have no clue where she is other than the notification that she is out and about. How do I go back to the previous version?

title: Please fix!
text: Just bought this for my Mom last month due to a fall in the shower. Now the app is worthless. I have even emailed GreatCall with no response. I hate to change the device after investing her money in this one. We new a working update!!

title: Doesn't work at this time
text: I bought the product for my mom because of this app. But even though we have activated it and I'm on the app it always tells me hers isn't activated or it is off. So far it does nothing for me and I'm leaving town. Ugh!!!

title: Terrible service...terrible app
text: Map locations are wrong, their emergency response team almost let my father die.  Don't trust this app or their promised service.

title: Great idea; poor functionality
text: GPS very often does not work at all. When it does work updates are in frequent. For example, it tells me my mom was out and about 2 1/2 hours ago. That's a long time to go without an update! The Help staff usually does try to be helpful; I just think the system needs a lot of improvement.

title: Not impressed
text:
Bought great call Splash with ultimate plan for my mother and Aunt.  Tested the devices and response time was under 10 seconds.  Great. Charge lasted several days. Good. Then I turned on fall protection.  When fall protection was turned on the battery life significantly decreased.  I have to recharge it after about 13-15 hours. Not good, and the rep told me that was standard for fall protection. I will have to turn off auto fall protection to keep the device on my moms neck and off of the cradle. The Great Call Link app is UNRELIABLE. It always shows battery charging, even when it's not on the charger.  The device status ALWAYS displays ON even when I've turned it off for the better part of the day.  The GPS seems to be working fine for the most part. The ability to check the device ALWAYS returns a server error.  I wish I could rely on this app but I can't.

Update:  The battery display appears to be working. Other than the GPS nothing else is working. My mom pressed the button. I thought I would get notified. Instead, that event became a tiny note in the app.  Summaries appear in reverse chronological order. I would not recommend paying extra for this app. The latest version did nothing to fix prior issues.

title: Not reliable
text: When this app works, it does a great job of tracking the phone user, and the mapping is accurate. Lately, it has been unable to locate the user or tells me the device is not on. This, even when I'm TALKING to the user on the land line, and she's confirming that her cell phone is on and charged. May be a network problem on Great Calls side, but since the main reason I got the Jitterbug phone for my 88 year old mom was to be able to track her, these outages are completely unacceptable.

title: Both frustrated user and bad experience user names were taken, how bad could it be?
text: Like a lot of customers have complained already - it only works for a few days, then everything stopped working. The 5*, the GPS, the battery indication, the greatcall link app, and, the customer service. They don't know the basics and they gave an impression that the Estimated fix time is just beyond your grace period. How can one rely on this for a life saving aid device for the elder-lies?

title: Love it
text: Love that I can keep track of my aunt. Also… knowing The devices charged and being used and is on perfect also love knowing when she's leaving the house and returns gives me peace of mind.

title: Needs an overhaul.
text:
Update- The app has not updated its status (battery level, locations, weekly reports, 5 star call info, etc.) since May 12th. It's now June 9th. 

The concept for the app is great. The functionality is lacking. You can't track more than one account (though that issue to me is bigger than the app since you can't have more than one person on an account). The locations are a bit buggy (the app likes to notify me often that my mother is in random places between 4-5am when I see that she's in bed asleep any time she actually leaves the home it tells me nothing). It is constantly showing that the device is charging even when she's wearing it. Rarely does it notify me that she's out and about; in fact most of the notifications never show up (except for those random places at 4-5 in the morning). It's slow; everything you try to do on the app is slow no matter your phone or connection. For the most part, I feel that it needs to be more functional. After all, more times than not the people using the app are not the ones wearing the devices/using the phones so it doesn't need to simplified so much that nothing works and what does work has little to no options for use.

title: GPS Stinks
text: Although I love the concept, in reality the GPS stinks! My 85 yr old mother has the splash. The app's GPS shows my mother being out and about all through the middle of the night when she's home in bed sleeping. This can be extremely frightening to loved ones. I've gotten Calls at 3am from concerned siblings!! Need to fix thi!

title: Unreliable
text: I had high hopes for this app, but as others have stated, it needs a major overhaul. Unreliable, says it's charging when it's around my mom's neck, says she's out and about the day AFTER she was actually out and about, weekly update doesn't update - I could go on and on. Being able to have all of her medications, dosages etc at hand is a feature plus, but using the app to keep up with my mom is useless.

title: Limited tracking
text: We bought this phone, not for an elder parent, but for our 13-year old son to use as his communication device when we need to take away his iPhone for disciplinary reasons.  For that purpose, it's fine. (It's actually a very humiliating phone for a teenager to carry around!)  But it does not offer the kind of real-time whereabouts information that the iPhone provides.  The "Jitterbug" only seems to ping the location server every 20 minutes or so.  When you need to know where your kid is right now, a message like "About 15 minutes ago Junior was out and about" is quite frustrating.

title: Has issues but just ok
text:
I have this and am disappointed in the problem of 1/2 the time it says it's not in service. I keep having to remove and put the app back on again on my phone and/or get my dad's phone and reboot it. Need to work on this to make it work better and the location issue needs to be more accurate. I hope someone from jitterbug can work on this and soon
Update...still needs a lot of work. Doesn't give correct info on location..regardless how much I remove and add the app, turn off and on my dad's phone still gives erroneous info. Now phone is always charging, even when it's not. Please fix these bugs--we have these apps for our loved ones but can't count on it to be accurate

title: Forget it
text: I bought this device with high hope that it would solve a problem with a 91 year old live alone dad out in the boonies. I was happy with it for the first few days then it went to crap. The app now shows the Splash is always in the charger, it always shows the power is on even when turned off for 30 minutes. For the last few days it always shows he is at home when I know he is not. I've been in touch with tech support many times.  The standard answer is turn it off turn it on maybe it will work by tomorrow.  Or better yet, "are you at home?  The device says your at home so that's ok." That's all it ever says these days.

title: App doesn't show location
text: Since I bought the phone for my father, the app doesn't show where he is. It always gives me an error saying that the device is not activated or 5star are having issues. It's been 2 weeks since and they still have not fixed it. This is the only reason I got this phone for my father. Really disappointed. Customer service keeps telling me it will take a couple of days to fix the issue and still not working 2 weeks later.

title: Inconsistent
text: For something this important the app gives false readings on battery life and on/off line.  It also indicates my Mom is Out and About often miles away when she hasn't moved outside her very small house.. In addition it indicates she hasn't used the fob for several days as if that's a bad thing.  When we press the button the app ultimately wakes up but it is unnerving.  We will have to look for more secure solutions.

title: Love My GreatLink
text: I was a bit hesitant to get the "GreatCall Splash" because I am JUST under 50. However, due to my medical conditions I am in dire need of something so my husband and daughter know I'm safe. My daughter loves that she gets notifications letting her know where I am! I haven't had ANY negative issues that I know of. The only problem I have is I clip the unit to my purse, and if I place it down carelessly, it thinks there's been a "Fall Detected" and I have to press the button right away to interrupt the call. It happens A LOT.

title: Peace of Mind
text:
This app gave my Mother such peace of mind.  Knowing that I know where she is at any moment, when she leaves home and keeps me updated continuously.

I wanted this for my benefit because of the GPS tracking and the falling feature-  and when she agreed I was thrilled. We both feel relief and peace of mind.

title: Keeping mom safe - Splash + Great Call service
text:
I live in a different state and use the system as a safeguard to ensure my 89 year old mother is safe at home. I primarily use the app to locate her and it works well in Phoenix. I can distinguish between her being in the backyard or in the house, or any other location she chooses to travel to in the area. It helps balance her independence and safety. 
I highly recommend Great Call service and the app for aging parents. The single button system is easy to use in an emergency or if she simply isn't feeling well. Thwy have her history and all relevant contact info. They know to call me if she has asked for help.

title: Not as good as some locators
text: The device does not update as quickly as a newer generation smart phone and either the device or the app result in showing a wrong location. When she is at home, the app shows her several hundred feet from her condo. If this were a single family home in a residential neighborhood, I would not worry so much but when it is a multi storied multi condo unit, I would worry that any first responders would be  misled. Last Sunday when she was in church, the app showed her on the fairway of one of the holes of a nearby golf course. I got a kick out of that! Bottom line, get Grandma an iPhone with "Find My Friends"

title: Very pleased.
text: My mother bought this for my father who had a few falls.  They are happier knowing that if something happens someone is there to get them help.  I feel less anxious being able to get updates with the app.

title: Bought one for mother in law also
text: My mom had the early version. Got the Splash for my mother in law. The app lets us keep tabs on her activities. Great to know she can push a button for help. AND YES it does work that way. Thank you Great Call.

title: Device is not all it advertises itself to be
text: The daily activity list is totally useless, it just does not work at all. I have programmed in seven of my mother's favorite places to go. Over the past week I have been testing it out by going to all of these places, and a device registers NOTHING but "Out and About"!!!!!!!

title: Good enough
text: I'm still new to this device and service. We chose it because my wife has aphasia from a stroke. The lanyard to charger transition is hard for her. I'm not sure the gps is good enough to locate my wife if she falls while away from home and her speech is impaired.

title: Only works part of the time
text:
Got this for my aging mother so I could keep track of her coming and goings. I had a feeling the app wasn't working quite right...my mom would tell me she had gone shopping yet the app never notified me. Another time I was notified that she left the house at 2:15am and returned at 4:30am. I asked her where she'd been and she said sleeping. Again the app was wrong. 
I don't know, but I sure hope Great Call see's all these comments everyone has written so they know there are issues with the app, devises and GPS system; it's not the user with the issue, especially when the same thing keeps happening over and over to different users.

title: Splash
text: This service need some work, I have my mother on the unit but there have been times that I received a message stating that she could not be located( what am I paying for?) The message also give bad locations some time up to ten miles away when she is sitting in her house. The tech stated that google maps showed the wrong location, I contacted google maps, reworked their location but the link is still getting things wrong. There has been times that I received messages that her unit is turned off, I call her and the unit is on but the link is not working. When it work it is good, but the question is "when it work?"

title: Really?
text: Does not work all the time. Not a good purchase if you really need something to work for an elderly person.

title: Ugh!
text: Just bought the Splash product for my mom and downloaded this app. It hasn't been able to connect to servers for days!! Don't they test their app before launching it??

title: Great tool
text: This app coupled with the god units my parents have gives me great relief. It allows me to know where my parents are without being intrusive.

title: Great - when it works
text: The app is great for helping to keep track of the whereabouts of my memory impaired father. Sadly however, it frequently loses the connection with my father's phone for no apparent reason. Then the app displays the message that "the 5 star device may be off or not in service". This happens even when his device is on and working properly from a phone standpoint.  This is the main reason we purchased the Jitterbug phone, so we could keep track of Dad and his whereabouts.  So sorry this app is not dependable and requires lots of time and tech service to get it working again. Hope this can be fixed.

title: Frustrating App!
text: This app is driving me crazy!  Very disappointed. It works sporadically and it's very unreliable. I live over 400 miles away from my 91 year old mother, and was hoping this app would provide me with some level of comfort in keeping connected to her when I'm not physically talking to her on the phone. It initially worked well, but shortly after started giving inaccurate information. It would indicate that my mother left home at 1:15 a.m. and returned at 1:45 a.m.  My mother lives alone and doesn't drive. Now I'm getting a message that says the device is turned off or not in service.  I've called support and I'm told the app is rarely wrong. The concept behind this app is great so I hope they find a way to fix these issues. I sure hope her actual device is functioning far more accurately than the smart phone app!

title: Disappointing GPS
text:
I looked forward to being able to know when my mom was out and about and then safely home but the GPS function is terrible.  Inaccurate location info.  Others have noted the delay in updates, which I am willing to allow for in order to limit the battery drain. But the lack of accuracy is not acceptable. The app has said mom has traveled a mile or more from home when she had not left the house all day. And other times it did not record a trip she did take. Very disappointed in this functionality.   

It does seem to be accurate on the battery level, however. I'm hoping they will work on the other issues as this app could be extremely useful to family members and other caregivers.

title: Great Call
text: My 87 year old mother lives 2000 miles from me and this lets me know she is OK-she feels more secure knowing she can get help anytime.

title: Needs some serious work!
text: Got my 86 year old mother a Jitterbug5 cause she needed a simpler phone, and I loved the option of having her GPS location via the app.  You should know that the GPS is only updated a few times an hour unless the "5Star" button is called, in which case it's updated every few seconds.  Even so, the map locator seems to work fairly well. However, the other features (being able to see battery level & status of phone) have only worked (i.e. shown up in my iPhone app) 2 days in the month and a half she's had it.  Nearly always says "the 5Star device may be off or not in service" - even when I am standing there holding the turned-on phone.  Very disappointing since we changed her phone service to Great Call (which cost more than the plan she had had) specifically to have this information.  We'll see.

title: Love this service
text: We have this for a loved one Lets you know when  they are out of the home and when they return . The greatcall service is extra piece of mind knowing they can contact emergency service and I will be notified in real time

title: Great all
text: This device seems to be what we need for our mom. Hopefully we will never have to use it. It give us a piece of mind to know when we are not with her, she has some backup.

title: So far, so good
text: Good service and excellent app for monitoring the parent when I am away.  I am worried about the battery that keeps showing half a charge when it has charged for nearly week solid without being taken off the charger, we shall see.

title: As RN, will be recommending to my patients
text: After a great deal of research I selected this device for my mom who lives with me and is home alone during my long shifts at work while, ironically, I take care of everyone else's mom.  I love that this app lets me check in on her & make sure she's wearing the device, and see if she's been up & around without having to call several times a day.  Also great for updating her meds and just the peace of knowing that if she should fall and not be able to speak, help will still come.  She won't face lying on the floor for hours until I got home.  Worth every penny.

title: Peace of Mind app for knowing your loved one is safe.
text:
This app allows you to know that status of your loved one 24 hours a day!  It's priceless. I'm 424 miles from my 90 year old Mother and I can even tell when the device needs to be charged. It can be used to locate someone that becomes lost if they are unable to communicate with you or others. 
A must have!

title: Daughter of a mobile mother
text: Great calls and it's app is the best service ever! If I put in known addresses the app tells me when she's there. It lets me know that her battery is charged and whether it is in the charging cradle (and therefore not on her person). It would also let me know if she made an emergency call or a fall is detected. The service delivers great peace of mind!!

title: Love, love, love it
text: My elderly mother is in a different state and I got her this for her as she lives alone.  The app lets me know when she is out and about, home and when she has used her device to emergency services. Helps keep my sanity in check and I could not live without it.

title: Works as promised: thrilled
text: Got a Jitterbug5 for my 89 year old dad who still gets out and about and needs an easy phone to use with an emergency panic button. The link app has worked flawlessly on my iPhone and always locates him within 30 feet: Love being able to locate him at any time. We have very good Verizon coverage in our area and maybe others have had spotty coverage, but I LOVE this app. I just checked to see that he got to his volunteer position . Never had a problem with support.

title: Disappointed
text: Never works. Calling support every week. The app always says out of service or not connected. And cannot locate my mother in law.  That was the point of getting this app.

title: Pretty, but useless
text: I had high hopes for this app to track my aunt.  But it really doesn't do much and the limited functionality that it does have is spotty. Battery levels not accurate and didn't notify me when there was a fall...isn't that the whole point?

title: Great device!
text: Love this medical alert system. After researching all the others this one seemed the best fit for my aunt. It is GPS so she can be found anywhere. I can check on her at anytime and the unit notifies me when she leaves and returns home. It also gives a review of her week and lets me know if she is wearing the alert necklace. I would recommend this to others.

title: This is great!
text: I'm so glad to be able to check on my mother when I am anxious about her safety!

title: Jitterbug, a Great tool
text: Keep tabs on and communication with a loved one while you help them manage their later years.  Very simple, effective.

title: Jitterbug5
text: Bought the Greatcall Jitterbug5 along with the Greatcall Link app. The Greatcall app is exactly what we've been looking for to track our Mom's comings and goings. Awesome peace of mind knowing where she is.

title: Finally a Life alert system that makes sense
text: I purchased this for my mom recently after pricing virtually every system on the market!  I also work in the in home security industry and this is better than what was available on the market at the time. My main reason for purchasing this was the GPS feature that would follow my mom anywhere. Also, with the ultimate pkg I and my siblings can be updated as to Her whereabouts, have the automatic fall detected feature, and on call medical staff.   One of the downfalls of this product is it is a bit large. But, it is an all in one product and my mom doesn't have to remember to take a second piece with her when she leaves the house. A fact that I have noticed in the clients I work with on my job, they forget to take the communicator portion with them when they leave the house!!!!  I highly recommend this product over any system currently available.

title: Mom
text: This app seems to be working good for me. It tracks the few times Mom leaves her apt & gives me weekly reports. Glad I have it.

title: Great reference for device
text: I love this App. It allows me to keep track of my 87 year old father when I am not with him. It shows me when he is out and when he has returned home. It also shows the battery level which is great, I can call him to remind him to charge it. It tells you when the battery is charging , so I can alo call and remind him to put the device back on. This App is great for those who have loved ones wearing this device, it allows you peace of mind

title: So far, so good
text: We got this for my mom because she lives alone. It gives my brother and I more peace of mind.

title: Great when it works
text: Our friend’s family is using this as they go through cancer with a four-year-old while having three other children at home aged 11 and two more four-year-olds. I Go into the app and I can’t get anything to show up. It just is a blank screen.  The website does weird things too. I wish it wasn’t so glitchy as I NEED to sign up for shifts next week but just cannot get the app to let me do it.

title: Doesn’t work. At all.
text: It won’t even start. I attempted to log in, and I just see a spinning death wheel that never ends next to my family team name. Such a bummer.

title: A caregiver's lifesaver!
text: I've used Lotsa Helping Hands to coordinate caregiving for years.  The  mobile app is just as good, if not easier!  No crashing, as another user experienced and I've used it a lot since it was released. Great to have on-the-go when you need to check who has signed up for different tasks. This app is a Godsend.

title: Crashes when adding to calendar
text: I have been considering using this for coordinating care of a loved one for a while so wanted to test out the app (iPhone only, no iPad app). Created an event, assigned it to myself and every time it asks if I want to add to my calendar and I say yes, it crashes. Froze upon reopen 2 out of 4 times I tried to get back in. Not useful or trustworthy if there are glitches like this.  Thanks for trying, look forward to an update.

title: Awful Update
text: I have used this app for years and have loved it. I’ve recommended it to family members and patients. It was very user friendly and reliable. With the latest update, it lags and is marking meds as “missed” when I repeatedly tried to mark it as “taken.” This is the ultimate reason I’ve decided to delete the app, but it’s worth mentioning that the addition of ads is annoying.

title: Free pill reminder
text:
I love this app. I have Parkinson’s but just recently had a TKR (total knee replacement). The myriad of medications was hard to keep track of. The app was the solution. 


Two statements: 

The symptom tracker is useful, but a bit awkward. I would love a comment area with each days symptom tracking. Giving some context to the day. 

I have a prolonged circle of thinking when I want to look at my med history. 

Suggestion:

Parkinson’s will take away my fine motor skills at some time. Is there the possibility of adding a speak to text option?

title: Critical Daily Tablet Dose Reminder in the Morning
text:
Daily it reminds you take your advised tablet 
If we miss one day there is a strain in the health system 
As senior citizens we forgot over other work 
This is 100% perfect 
It reminds you and we fell happy that we are taking our Tablet as advised by our Physcian 
Good health is a wealth to us and to our family

title: My first visit…a success
text:
I would recommend this app for anybody that’s had a visit with a doctor, and hasn’t recalled all of the responses. In a short period of time, Kin produced concise summary of a visit with my specialist. It’s so simple: set up the free app; bring your phone to a visit; tell the doctor you’d like to record; press start, and then stop. In a short time you get a report for your use, or share with a family member.

In addition to personal visits, you can record a telephone conversation. There’s an extra step because you can’t speak and record on the same device. You can take a call over your Mac or PC, and use your phone to record. This is a great app, and I’d recommend highly.
